detailed_description: The Open Graph Generator creates a basic browser-side Open Graph meta tag snippet from form fields. You can enter a title, description, URL, image URL, site name, and type, then review a simple card-style preview and the generated HTML textarea. The output includes `og:type`, `og:url`, `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`, and `og:site_name`, with attribute values escaped before insertion. The preview uses the provided image and hostname when available. The tool does not validate OGP compliance, check image size or MIME type, enforce character limits, generate Twitter Card tags, add product or video-specific properties, detect missing metadata from a live URL, or provide copy/download controls.
usage_steps: Enter the page title and description.
Add the page URL and image URL if you want them included in the tags and preview.
Choose one of the available Open Graph types.
Review the preview and generated HTML snippet, then copy the text manually if needed.
usage_examples: Draft basic Open Graph tags for a blog post landing page.
Preview how a title, description, and image URL may look in a simple card layout.
Generate starter `og:site_name` and `og:type` markup for a small website.
Copy the generated textarea content into an HTML head section for manual review.
